verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own GraphQL platform API, programmatic agent management, an MCP server and event subscriptions, so it has a substantial first-party API. Nothing in the evidence states that this API matches what the UI can do. Missing for 10: an explicit claim or reference proving UI-to-API parity (e.g. views, dashboards, admin settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
